## What's free

Free for 5 users: unlimited private repos, 50 Pipelines build minutes/month, 1 GB LFS, 1 GB storage per repository

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

Build minutes and storage are shared across the workspace.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
